page.layout: Two columns side by side, separated by a vertical rule: left column (מ ר entries, Hebrew lemmata with Latin glosses) and right column (מ ד entries). Running heads at the top of each column. No text below the columns and no marginal notes.

main_text.l: unde & No. f. fæm. מְרִירוּת amaritudo.
כְּמְרִירֵי sicut amaritudines, No. pl. m. constr. præf. Rad. מָרַר; vel æstus, nigredines, No. pl. m. gem. à Rad. כָּמַר
מַרְכָּב sedile, equitatus, מַרְכָּבָה currus, מַרְכָּבוֹת currûs, No. f. m. & f. & No. pl. f. R. רָכַב equitavit.
No. f. fæm. מַרְכֹּלֶת, præf. aff. Rad. רָכַל mer-cator.
מַרְכְּסֵי à perversitatibus, No. pl. m. constr. רְכְסֵי.
præf. qu. à sing. מַרְכֵּס vel מַרְכָּס, Rad. רָכַס li-gavit.
מִרְמָה fraus, מִרְמוֹת fraudes, No. f. & pl. fæm. Rad. רָמָה projecit.
מְרַע, מֵרַע, & רַע malefi-cus, malefaciens, No. vel Part. Hiph. f. m. Rad. רוּעַ malum esse.
מְרֵעַ amicus, מְרֵעֵהוּ, & מְרֵעֵהוּ ejus, &c. No. f. m. aff. Rad. רָעָה pascere.
מֶרַע, vel מָרַע à malo, No. f. m., רַע, vel רָע, præf. Rad. רוּעַ malum esse.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and some Hebrew roots are hard to read at this scan resolution; the points are copied as best seen and not all are certain. The lemma of the first right-hand entry (under "in mercatu") is partly obscured. Words in italics (rebelles, jaculantes, vociferantes, evacuantes, amarus, amarum esse, malefaciens, pascere, etc.) are set in italic type as printed. Page number at head left is a damaged symbol and could not be read.
